literal: Fame since it does not yield, to the world of gods it will not lead, what then is the use of going and standing behind those who despise?
translation: If it yields no fame on earth and does not lead to the world of the gods, what is the use of going and standing in subservience behind those who despise you?
modern: ஒருவருக்குப் புகழையும் தராது, தேவர் உலகத்திற்கும் வழிநடத்தாது என்றால், தம்மை இகழ்ந்து பேசுபவர்களின் பின்னால் சென்று அடங்கி நிற்பதால் என்ன பயன் விளையும்?
explanation: This couplet highlights the futility of compromising one's self-respect for material or social gain. The poet argues that bowing down and serving those who hold you in contempt (இகழ்வார் பின் சென்று நிலை) brings absolutely no benefit. It neither earns you honor and fame (புகழ்) in this earthly life, nor does it pave the way to the heavenly realm of the gods (புத்தேள் நாடு) in the afterlife. Since it serves no purpose in either world, maintaining one's dignity is the only honorable path.
